entry.author: Wellington City Libraries
entry.summary:
One of our Music Specialists walks you through how to set up our Podcast-Zoom Equipment Kit, with two Rode NT1-A microphones with phantom power on a Zoom recorder — a vital step for making this gear work together smoothly. This setup process can be a bit tricky if you're not familiar with the equipment, so this video breaks it down step by step.

You'll also learn how to transfer the recorded audio files from the Zoom recorder to your laptop, making it easier to start editing your podcast right away.
